title: Online IB Biology Tutoring SL & HL | Auxesis Education
description: Individualized online IB Biology tutoring for SL and HL, including conceptual understanding, exam preparation and ethical IA guidance.
heading: Online IB Biology tutoring
intro: Build understanding, connect biological ideas and learn to communicate scientific reasoning clearly in IB Biology at Standard or Higher Level.
sections: Work from understanding

Biology becomes more manageable when students can explain how processes connect. Lessons use the student’s course and questions to explore concepts, interpret diagrams and data, and apply knowledge to unfamiliar contexts.
Prepare for assessment

We practise working with command terms, selecting relevant evidence and explaining reasoning. Exam preparation can include reviewing difficult topics, analysing questions and developing a practical study approach.
Internal Assessment guidance

I can help students think through their research question, methods, analysis and evaluation. The decisions, analysis and final submitted work remain the student’s own, in keeping with academic integrity.
An experienced teacher

I am an Ontario Certified Teacher holding Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) in the United Kingdom. My experience includes international classroom teaching and work as an IB Biology Assistant Examiner, including Internal Assessment moderation.

title: Online IB Chemistry Tutoring SL & HL | Auxesis Education
description: Online one-to-one IB Chemistry tutoring for SL and HL, with conceptual explanations, problem-solving, exam preparation and ethical IA guidance.
heading: Online IB Chemistry tutoring
intro: Make sense of chemical ideas, calculations and explanations with individualized support for IB Chemistry at Standard or Higher Level.
sections: Connect models and evidence

Lessons begin with the student’s course, questions and prior understanding. We work on the models behind the chemistry and practise moving between observations, equations, calculations and explanations.
Practise applying knowledge

A student may understand a topic in class but struggle to apply it in an unfamiliar question. We identify the steps in a problem, consider units and assumptions, and explain the reasoning rather than memorising a procedure.
Prepare for assessments
We can review challenging topics, practise interpreting questions and develop a study approach suited to upcoming assessments. The focus is on both understanding and clear communication.
Internal Assessment guidance
Guidance can support planning, interpretation and evaluation while protecting academic integrity: the student makes the decisions and produces their own analysis and final submitted work.

title: GCSE & IGCSE Biology and Chemistry Tutoring | Auxesis
description: Online GCSE and IGCSE Biology and Chemistry tutoring, including Biology and Chemistry components of Combined Science and preparation for further study.
heading: GCSE and IGCSE science tutoring
intro: One-to-one support in Biology and Chemistry that helps students build foundations, practise applying ideas and prepare for their next stage of science.
sections: Biology and Chemistry, matched to the course

Lessons follow the student’s examination board, specification and classroom work. We can revisit difficult concepts, make links between topics and use questions to test whether the explanation makes sense.
Combined and Coordinated Science

Support is available for the Biology and Chemistry components. Courses differ by examination board, so share the specification or topics when enquiring and I can confirm whether the support is suitable.
Build toward the next qualification

Students may benefit from strengthening foundations before examination courses, working consistently during GCSE or IGCSE, or revisiting key ideas before moving to IB or A-Level Biology. Support is adjusted to the student rather than assuming the same pathway for everyone.
Experienced science teaching
I am an Ontario Certified Teacher holding Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) in the United Kingdom, with international classroom experience in GCSE and IGCSE Biology and Chemistry.

title: Online AS & A-Level Biology Tutoring | Auxesis Education
description: Online AS and A-Level Biology tutoring for understanding advanced concepts, interpreting data and preparing for examinations.
heading: Online AS and A-Level Biology tutoring
intro: Explore demanding biological concepts and develop the confidence to explain and apply them in the context of the student’s own course.
sections: Understand the detail

We work from the student’s specification, class materials and questions. Lessons can connect molecular processes with larger biological systems, strengthen prior knowledge and address ideas that have become difficult.
Apply ideas and interpret evidence

Students practise interpreting data and practical investigations, selecting relevant biological knowledge and explaining how evidence supports a conclusion. The work follows the requirements of their course and examination board.
Prepare for examinations and further study

Assessment preparation can include reviewing topics, practising structured questions and identifying where explanations need greater precision. Stronger understanding also supports the transition to further biological or scientific study.
Experience across curricula
I am an Ontario Certified Teacher holding Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) in the United Kingdom, with international teaching experience including AS and A-Level Biology.
